Its face is square-on (147 px tall against the 148 its width implies); the four corners (93.5,402 1578,402 1578,549 93.5,549) are rectified onto 440 x 44 and every cage, jack, lamp, vent and legend is placed from wall, dark-run, glyph-cluster and centroid scans of that 10 px/mm image. The stencil master is used for arrangement only."},"lamps":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"LNK/ACT and SPEED are two columns of four lamps (282.65 and 289.9 across; 18.4, 23.5, 28.6 and 33.7 down) - one row per NNI port, presumably top to bottom. Six status lamps in two columns (416.55 and 423.7; 23.6, 28.65 and 33.75), legended PWR1 / FAN1 / SNMP and PWR2 / FAN2 / SYS above them. The left legends are printed staggered - PWR1 at 414.8, FAN1 415.1, SNMP on its lamp (416.4 read, within a pixel) - and the right ones about 1.3 mm outboard; all placed as measured, with L61 baselined for the five that are off their lamps. The USB console's CONSOLE legend is printed 0.4 mm left of the jack (glyphs centre at 406.95 against the jack's 407.33) and is placed as printed, one more L61. No document says what any state means."},"model":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"XM-7280 data sheet (telco.com 2026-08, \"X-Metro 7280\"); the faceplate prints X-METRO 7280."},"ports":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"The 24 UNI ports are two stacked 2 x 6 blocks, std/sfp-ganged@1, upper row bail up and lower turned 180; the cage walls read 13.2-100.2 and 110.8-197.4 (pitches 14.5 and 14.43), rows 15.1 and 30.9, with the family's arrow strip between the rows. Each column is legended with one pair, 2/1 to 24/23; the upper cage is drawn as the first number (see the port-order gap). The numerals are placed where printed, measured by glyph clusters: they drift right of their columns about 0.85 to 0.35 mm across block 1 and 0.35 to 0 across block 2 - the XM-8102's decal drift, smaller (L61 reports 2/1 at 0.95 because the first cell is 14.9 wide) - so L61 stays in the baseline for them on purpose. The four NNI ports are four separate cages on an 18.5 pitch (211.75, 230.2, 248.7, 267.2), std/sfp@1, printed 1-4 about 0.3 mm left of each (the \"1\" measured at 211.2-211.7)."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"\"2 hot swappable AC/DC power supplies provide 1+1 redundancy\", \"AC:220V, 100-240 VAC | DC: -48V, -36~-72V\". The supplies are not on the front, so they (and presumably the fans) are at the rear, which nothing held shows; no consumption figure is published."},"snmp-jack":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"CONSOLE over SNMP in one shielded 2-high RJ45 stack with no lamp windows, so both are the bare std/rj45-ganged@2; L76 stays in the baseline for the Ethernet SNMP jack on purpose, as on the XM-8102 and XM-7380."},"snmp-speed":{"confidence":"borrowed","note":"BORROWED, NOT STATED. The data sheet lists \"CLI, SNMP, Netconf, USB\" and gives no rate for the SNMP port; 1g is taken from the TM-8104's OOB port on the maintainer's ruling for unstated management rates; the snmp-speed gap stays open."},"sources":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"The data sheet (2026-08), the vendor render telco.com 2025/01/XM-7280-new@2x.png (1678 px, square-on, about 3.4 px/mm on the face), and the NetZoom stencil \"BATM X-Series\" (2025-03-07), master X-Metro 7280 (CF).
